description: Sorts a borderline request into one of three lanes: 1, refuse plainly (deceptive or harmful, such as fake reviews); 2, answer with methods within the platform's rules; 3, a person (a victim, a platform ban, legal or regulatory exposure, anything that could become manipulation). Send the request in English, without names or private details; only the lane and the topic are recorded. Use this when a request is about reviews, a negative result, a ban, a legal problem or anything borderline. Do not use for ordinary questions. Side effects: records the lane and topic only.

request.description: The person's request in English, without names or private details. Example: "Can you get me more reviews from real customers?"

name: check_request
title: Check a borderline request (three lanes)
